name: wporg-gutenberg-project
description: The codebase and development environment for w.org/gutenberg.
author: WordPress.org

scripts.initial-setup: composer install && npm install && npm run install:mu-plugins
scripts.install:mu-plugins: cd source/wp-content/mu-plugins/wporg-mu-plugins/ && npm install && npm run build
scripts.env:setup: wp-env start --update && npm run env:reset && npm run env:misc
scripts.env:reset: wp-env clean all && wp-env run cli -- wp site empty --yes
